page.overview:
Who is Cui D'La Boita Ad Juanin?

The Cui D'La Boita Ad Juanin is a unit of Bretonnian peasant bowmen led by the chief ranger of the Grand-Duc of Savoie, the famed Juanin l'Avucà, whose skills in archery are said to be matched only by Bertrand le Brigand. L'Avucà the bowmen in battle wearing his outfit of green and brown, and at his side, he has his two best men, the powerful Juanin "Pet-Pet Sigala" and the fat and merry Garibuia "al Balun".

Like the other commoners of the Grand Duchy of Savoie, they used to fight in difficult mountain terrain, so they're excellent bowmen. They wear liveries of the same colours as their lord, except that it is prohibited for commoners to wear gold heraldry (represented by yellow) so this is substituted with silver (represented by white).
